request.prompt_head:
The person asks:
Until when can I cancel my electricity contract because of the price increase?

response.text:
Ordnung has **not stored a specific deadline** for the special right to cancel due to this price increase — there's no computed to-do for it, only the letter itself.

- The letter about the price increase says [doc:doc_asph8a6ddy4e] you have a special right to cancel without notice under § 41 Abs. 5 EnWG, and that your cancellation must reach the provider before the price change takes effect on "01.11.2026" (the letter's date, not independently verified by Ordnung).
- The regular contract cancellation date Ordnung has calculated for this electricity contract is different: after the minimum term, you can cancel any time with one month's notice, and if it arrives by Fri 2 Oct 2026 the contract would end Mon 2 Nov 2026 [contract:ctr_bbzemyapzvm5].

Since the special-price-increase deadline is only mentioned in the letter and not confirmed as a stored Ordnung deadline, I'd suggest:
- Double-check the exact cut-off with Stadtwerke Musterstadt directly (or the paper letter), since it must simply **arrive before the new prices take effect**.
- If you want to act on it, you can use "Draft letter" in Ordnung to send your cancellation citing § 41 Abs. 5 EnWG well before that date, to be safe.

Sehr geehrter Herr Rivera,

die Kosten der Stromversorgung sind im laufenden Jahr deutlich gestiegen. Insbesondere die Entgelte
für die Nutzung der Stromnetze, die der örtliche Netzbetreiber festlegt, sowie unsere

Preisbestandteil   bisher (brutto)   ab 01.11.2026 (brutto)

brutto, also um 70,20 € pro Jahr. Ihren monatlichen Abschlag passen wir deshalb ab dem 15.11.2026
von 48,00 € auf 54,00 € an.

Ihr Sonderkündigungsrecht

Wirksamwerdens der Preisänderung in Textform zu kündigen (§ 41 Abs. 5 Energiewirtschaftsgesetz
